for.hints.smelter.desc: 可以使用熔炼炉制备金属合金。开始熔炼之前，熔炼炉必须预热到足够的温度！（You can use a smelter to alloy metals. Before any smelting can occur, the Smelter must warm up to a sufficient temperature!）
for.jei.description.bituminous_peat: 与其他化合物混合以帮助干燥的泥炭，其燃烧速度远低于普通泥炭，燃烧时间超过普通泥炭的两倍。（Peat that has been mixed with other compounds to aid it in drying out, causing it burn much slower than normal peat, lasting over twice as long.）
for.jei.description.brewer_bag: 提供额外储物空间，自动拾取与药水相关的物品。（Extra inventory that automatically picks up potion-related items.）
for.jei.description.experience_drop: 可以放入榨汁机转化为液态经验。随后将玻璃瓶放入榨汁机的流体容器槽，即可获得附魔之瓶。（Can be put in the Squeezer and turned into Liquid Experience. You can then put a Glass Bottle in the Squeezer's fluid container slot to recieve a Bottle o' Enchanting.）
for.jei.description.phosphor_torch: 可以放置在水下。（Can be placed underwater.）
for.jei.description.scoop_proven: 捕虫网用于破坏世界中的蜂巢，并收集其中的蜜蜂。也可以右键点击蝴蝶来捕捉。标定捕虫网比普通捕虫网更加坚固可靠，只能从村民处购买。（The Scoop is used to break bee hives found in the world, it will collect the bees inside. It can also be used to catch butterflies by right-clicking them. Is much stronger and more reliable than a normal scoop. They can only be purchased from villagers.）
item.forestry.brewer_bag_woven: 编织酿造背包（Woven Brewing Backpack）
item.forestry.grafter.tooltip: 确保破坏树叶时掉落树苗。（Guarantees saplings drop from broken leaves.）
item.forestry.grafter_proven.tooltip: 确保破坏树叶时掉落树苗。（Guarantees saplings drop from broken leaves.）
item.forestry.scoop_proven.tooltip: 破坏蜂巢以收集蜜蜂。（Break hives to collect bees.）
